verdict.rationale: Okta ships an official MCP server that exposes its Admin Management APIs to AI agents, with documented natural-language examples like 'Create a new user and add them to the Engineering group' and 'Show me all failed login attempts from the last 24 hours', letting AI-native users drive Okta via NL commands through an MCP client. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that these NL commands work reliably in practice, and no evidence of a native NL interface built directly into the Okta admin console itself.
